    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament will take place from
    April 9–12, 2026, at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia. As the first men's major golf championship of the year, tournament play runs from Thursday to Sunday, with practice rounds beginning on Monday, April 6. 
    Key 2026 Masters Dates 
    • Practice Rounds: April 6–8
    • Par 3 Contest: Wednesday, April 8
    • Tournament Rounds (First): Thursday, April 9
    • Tournament Rounds (Second): Friday, April 10
    • Tournament Rounds (Third): Saturday, April 11
    • Final Round & Green Jacket Ceremony: Sunday, April 12 
    Coverage of the tournament typically airs on ESPN and CBS, with streaming options available on Paramount+ and the official Masters website.

    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters Tournament (April 9–12) features expanded coverage, with
    Amazon Prime Video (1–3 p.m. ET) and ESPN (3–7:30 p.m. ET) covering Thursday/Friday, while Paramount+ (noon–2 p.m. ET) and CBS (2–7 p.m. ET) air the weekend rounds. "Live From the Masters" precedes coverage on Golf Channel. 
    2026 Masters TV & Streaming Schedule (All Times ET) 
    • Thursday, April 9 (Round 1): 1–3 p.m. (Amazon Prime), 3–7:30 p.m. (ESPN)
    • Friday, April 10 (Round 2): 1–3 p.m. (Amazon Prime), 3–7:30 p.m. (ESPN)
    • Saturday, April 11 (Round 3): 12–2 p.m. (Paramount+), 2–7 p.m. (CBS)
    • Sunday, April 12 (Final Round):
      12–2 p.m. (Paramount+), 2–7 p.m. (CBS)
       
    Key Coverage Details 
    • Digital Coverage: Featured groups and Amen Corner coverage are available on Masters.com and the Masters App.
    • "Live From" the Masters: Golf Channel offers morning and post-round analysis.
    • Morning Coverage: There is no traditional TV coverage of early morning tee times, only digital, per Yahoo Sports.
    • New for 2026: "Mornings at the Masters" streams on YouTube.
